title: Atlas DataFlow Run Evidence
description: Minimum internal run/build evidence schema for the M14 traceability layer. Records reduced identity, input, output, timestamp, status, hash, and failure fields for a technical execution. This schema is internal operational evidence only — run evidence must not be treated as a release candidate, published release, active release record, or public dataset metadata. Raw logs, raw runtime data, raw API payloads, secrets, and private local paths are prohibited.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this reduced run/build evidence document.

run_identity.description: Stable identifier fields for the technical run. Must not expose private session details, raw execution identifiers, or secrets.

run_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this run or build execution.

run_type.description: Category of the technical run. Must not expose raw execution mode labels.

producer.description: Pipeline component or script that produced this run evidence. Must not expose private paths or secrets.

run_inputs.description: Reduced reference to the run's input artifacts. Must use path references or slugs only — not raw artifact content, not private local paths, not secrets.

input_ref.description: Reduced reference to the primary input artifact or contract. Must not embed raw content or private absolute paths.

input_hash.description: Optional integrity hash of the primary input artifact. Must not expose raw content.

run_outputs.description: Reduced reference to the run's output artifacts. Must use path references or artifact role references only — not raw artifact content.

output_ref.description: Reduced reference to the primary output artifact or directory. Must not embed raw artifact contents.

output_hash.description: Optional integrity hash of the primary output artifact or manifest. Must not expose raw content.

run_timestamps.description: ISO 8601 timestamps for run start and completion. Must not include raw process timing or raw runtime profiling data.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run started.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run completed (success, rejection, or failure).

run_status.description: Outcome of the run. Must not expose raw exit codes, raw runtime signals, or raw error payloads.

failure_info.description: Optional reduced failure or rejection information. Present only when run_status is rejected or failed. Must not include raw stack traces, raw log output, raw error payloads, or secrets.

failure_reason.description: Short reduced description of why the run failed. Must not embed raw log output or raw exception details.

rejection_reason.description: Short reduced description of why the run was rejected. Must not embed raw validation payloads or raw error details.

run_boundary_confirmations.description: Explicit confirmation that this evidence record describes a technical run only. Run evidence must never be treated as or written to release candidate, published release, or active release records.

is_release_candidate.description: Run evidence must never claim to be a release candidate record.

is_published_release.description: Run evidence must never claim to be a published release record.

is_active_release.description: Run evidence must never claim to be an active release record.

evidence_policy.description: Safety policy for reduced run/build evidence. All flags are required and fixed. Mirrors the M13 build-evidence.schema.json evidence_policy convention.
